title: The Secret
author: OtomeGirl4Ever
summary:
For eons, Ratchet and Optimus Prime have loved each other in silence, never needing grand declarations for the Autobots to know the truth. But when Ratchet discovers he is sparkled, Optimus becomes more than a Prime—he becomes a sire, fiercely devoted to the small blue-opticked tricolor seekerling who enters their lives like a hidden star.
For vorns, the Autobots protect the secret of Starscream: a brilliant youngling raised among them, cherished by his creators, and already sharp enough to aid the Autobot cause with a mind far beyond his years.
But secrets do not remain buried forever.
When the Decepticons finally place a spy inside Autobot ranks, Megatron learns the impossible truth: Optimus Prime and Ratchet have a sparkling… and that sparkling is no ordinary child.

summary:
The battlefield was silent. Not peaceful (Cybertron had forgotten peace long ago) but silent in the way a frame fell quiet after surviving too much pain.
Jetfire knelt beside the containment chamber cradled in his hands. Within it floated a tiny sphere of yellow light. Starscream's spark. It flickered weakly.
"...Still here," Jetfire whispered.
For the first time in countless stellar cycles, his voice held hope instead of obedience.
